title: The appraisal notice jumps
summary: Calendar the protest deadline, gather evidence and decide whether to protest on your own or with an agent.

situation.trigger: The property tax appraisal notice comes in far above the expected value.

outlineSteps: Calendar the protest deadline the day the notice arrives
Read the notice's land, improvement and total values
Compute what the new value would do to the tax bill
Gather income, sales and condition evidence
Decide whether to protest yourself or hire an agent
Present the case at the hearing
Update the budget and the lender's tax escrow
Pass the result through to tenants as the leases require
Tell the lender and investors the result and record it
